decision: held: three of the four declared sources (40210172 glycaemic meta-analysis, 37341696 blood-pressure meta-analysis, 21675032 seed-capsule diabetes trial) have no open full text, so the glycaemic/BP evidence behind the key endpoints cannot be verified; the one open source (34407441, open-label COVID-19 trial) is approved without credit.
summary: 34407441: open-label RCT in adults with mild COVID-19; Cuminmar Nigella sativa oil 500 mg twice daily for 10 days plus usual care improved 14-day symptom recovery (62% vs 36%), with an internal participant-count discrepancy (173 vs 183). The glycaemic and BP meta-analyses that would support the record's metabolic endpoints are abstract-only. The record declares no health-goal claim and stays held.

population.description: Adults (>=18, mean age 36, 53% male) with mild PCR-confirmed COVID-19 at King Abdulaziz University Hospital, Jeddah, May-September 2020; abstract reports 173 enrolled (86 NSO, 87 control), the baseline table and results report 183 (91 vs 92).

study_contexts.study_design: Open-label randomized controlled trial (1:1, centralized web randomization) of Nigella sativa oil plus standard of care vs standard of care alone; NCT04401202.

outcomes.name: Primary: recovery (symptom-free 3 days) within 14 days: 62% vs 36% in abstract (p=0.001); 63% vs 35% in Results
Mean time to recovery shorter with NSO (10.7 ± 3.2 vs 12.3 ± 2.8 days)

limitations: Open-label with usual-care control and telephone-reported subjective symptoms; authors call for placebo-controlled double-blind confirmation.
Abstract and full-text counts disagree (173 vs 183 participants; 54/86 vs 57/91 recovered); the discrepancy is retained, not resolved.
Not scoring eligible: unblinded acute-infection treatment trial; the record declares no health-goal claim and no infection treatment or prevention claim is supported for supplements.
Returned decision A049: source-content hold; methods verified for this source only.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

dosage_forms: not reported by source: oral Nigella sativa oil preparation (Cuminmar)
co_therapies: Standard of care for mild COVID-19 in both arms.
dose.reported_regimen: Nigella sativa oil 500 mg twice daily (1,000 mg/day) for 10 days plus standard of care.

normalization.basis: 2 x 500 mg = 1,000 mg/day oil as assigned.

source_provenance.location: Abstract; Methods (participants, randomization, intervention, primary outcome); Results Tables 1-3
